# Maarten de Klerk — Portfolio

> UI/UX Designer & Web Developer from Nijswiller, the Netherlands (South Limburg). Brand and web for small businesses in Limburg — visual identities, websites and web apps — combining frontend development, UI/UX design, and visual/motion design. Studies Digital Design (Graduaat Digitale Vormgeving) at Hogeschool PXL. Available for new projects.

- [About (EN)](/en/about.html): English version of the about page.
- [Projects (NL)](/nl/projecten.html): Portfolio of web, app, design, and motion projects, filterable by category.
- [Projects (EN)](/en/projects.html): English version of the projects page.
- [Contact (NL)](/nl/contact.html): Contact form, email, phone, and social links.
- [Contact (EN)](/en/contact.html): English version of the contact page.
